Frigibax

Dragon Ice

Paldea · Generation 9

Frigibax is a Dragon/Ice-type Ice Fin Pokémon first found in Paldea (Generation 9). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 17 kg. It evolves into Arctibax. Its highest base stat is Attack (75), with a base stat total of 320.
